harmful_ingredients.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
harmful_ingredients.reason: Linked to obesity, insulin resistance, and metabolic syndrome

harmful_ingredients.name: Trans Fat / Partially Hydrogenated Oil
harmful_ingredients.reason: Raises LDL cholesterol and lowers HDL; banned by the FDA but trace amounts persist

harmful_ingredients.name: BHA
harmful_ingredients.reason: Potential carcinogen; listed as possibly carcinogenic to humans by IARC

harmful_ingredients.name: BHT
harmful_ingredients.reason: Linked to tumor promotion in animal studies; avoid where possible

harmful_ingredients.name: TBHQ
harmful_ingredients.reason: Synthetic preservative linked to vision disturbances and liver effects at high doses

harmful_ingredients.name: Sodium Nitrate / Nitrite
harmful_ingredients.reason: Forms carcinogenic nitrosamines when cooked at high heat

harmful_ingredients.name: Artificial Colors
harmful_ingredients.reason: Linked to hyperactivity in children; some are derived from petroleum

harmful_ingredients.name: Azodicarbonamide
harmful_ingredients.reason: Dough conditioner banned in Europe and Australia; WHO links it to respiratory issues

harmful_ingredients.name: Brominated Vegetable Oil
harmful_ingredients.reason: Bromine accumulates in body tissue; banned in Europe and Japan

harmful_ingredients.name: Aspartame
harmful_ingredients.reason: Classified as possibly carcinogenic to humans (IARC Group 2B) in 2023

harmful_ingredients.name: Sucralose
harmful_ingredients.reason: May negatively alter gut microbiome; genotoxic in recent studies

harmful_ingredients.name: Acesulfame Potassium
harmful_ingredients.reason: Animal studies link it to cancer risk; limited human safety data

harmful_ingredients.name: Saccharin
harmful_ingredients.reason: Formerly listed as a carcinogen; still controversial; disrupts gut bacteria

harmful_ingredients.name: Carrageenan
harmful_ingredients.reason: Derived from seaweed but linked to gut inflammation and digestive issues

harmful_ingredients.name: Seed Oils
harmful_ingredients.reason: High in omega-6 linoleic acid; excessive consumption linked to inflammation

harmful_ingredients.name: Sodium Benzoate
harmful_ingredients.reason: Forms benzene (carcinogen) when combined with Vitamin C; linked to hyperactivity

harmful_ingredients.name: Potassium Bromate
harmful_ingredients.reason: Classified as possibly carcinogenic; banned in EU, UK, and Canada

harmful_ingredients.name: Polysorbate 80
harmful_ingredients.reason: Emulsifier that may disrupt gut barrier and alter microbiome in animal studies

harmful_ingredients.name: Caramel Color (IV)
harmful_ingredients.reason: Class IV caramel color contains 4-MEI, a potential carcinogen

harmful_ingredients.name: Maltodextrin
harmful_ingredients.reason: High glycemic index sugar substitute that spikes blood sugar faster than glucose

harmful_ingredients.name: Artificial Flavor
harmful_ingredients.reason: Catch-all term that may mask MSG or other additives

harmful_ingredients.name: MSG
harmful_ingredients.reason: Generally recognized as safe, but some individuals report sensitivity symptoms
